name: Create RPGLE Program
command: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(&DEBUG_VIEW) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

name: Create RPGLE Module
command: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(&DEBUG_VIEW) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

name: Create SQLRPGLE Program
command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(&DEBUG_VIEW) CLOSQLCSR(*ENDMOD) CVTCCSID(*JOB) COMPILEOPT('TGTCCSID(*JOB)') RPGPPOPT(*LVL2)

name: Create SQLRPGLE Module
command: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCSTMF('&RELATIVEPATH') OBJTYPE(*MODULE) OPTION(*EVENTF) DBGVIEW(&DEBUG_VIEW) CLOSQLCSR(*ENDMOD) CVTCCSID(*JOB) COMPILEOPT('TGTCCSID(*JOB)') RPGPPOPT(*LVL2)

name: Create Physical file
command: CRTPF FILE(&CURLIB/&NAME) SRCFILE(&SRCFILE) SRCMBR(&NAME) OPTION(*EVENTF) SIZE(*NOMAX) MAXMBRS(1)
